description:
Local OpenAI-compatible router that aggregates free LLM providers.

FreeLLMAPI aggregates the free tiers of dozens of LLM providers, plus custom OpenAI-compatible chat, embedding, image, and audio endpoints, behind a single /v1 API.

A router picks the best available model for each request, falls over to the next provider when one is rate-limited, and tracks per-key usage so you stay under every free-tier cap. Provider keys are stored encrypted, and the router refreshes its model catalog from a signed feed. Built for personal use only; each provider's terms of service apply.
New
- Round-robin key selection: a new strategy that rotates evenly through the keys of a provider. Choose it in the routing settings. The default is unchanged. Thanks @Aniketchavan7. (#2022, #2027)
- Copy API URL button: each key row on the Keys page has a button that copies the provider's API base URL. Thanks @flipcyde101. (#2020, #2031)
- Clearer 429 errors: when every route is blocked, the error now says why (cause: cooldown, provider limit, quota and so on), in the body and in X-Block-Cause headers. Thanks @FabioLeitao. (#2118)
- CLI: freellmapi keys add reads the provider key from FREELLMAPI_PROVIDER_KEY or piped stdin, so the key stays out of the command line. Thanks @w21180239. (#2100)
Fixes
- Failover on HTTP 405: a relay that answers 405 (a login or firewall page) no longer stops the request. The gateway tries the next route. Thanks @zhangsheng377. (#1999)
- Cloudflare neuron cap: one oversized call no longer blocks the whole Cloudflare account until midnight UTC. A call that does not fit is skipped and the request goes to the next provider. Calls now reserve max_tokens up front, so clients that send very large max_tokens use Cloudflare less. Thanks @tevasas. (#2016)
- Token usage on streamed Gemini and Ollama requests: usage now shows the provider's real counts instead of an estimate. Thanks @chuenchen309. (#2128)
- *.localhost custom providers: names such as ollama.localhost now work on systems whose DNS does not resolve them. Thanks @ixABK. (#2038)
- Media models: catalog sync no longer removes or overwrites media models that a user added. Thanks @w21180239. (#2099)
